question: Should this Feishu newline branch remain a candidate without live Feishu proof, or should maintainers require proof or choose another canonical candidate for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/97074?
rationale: External PRs need after-fix real behavior proof, and the same bug has several open candidate PRs, including one with screenshot proof but an unmergeable state.

options.title: Require proof on this branch
options.body: Keep this PR open but require redacted Feishu client/API proof plus conflict resolution before considering it canonical.

options.title: Use a proof-positive sibling after repair
options.body: Designate a sibling such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99394 only after its conflicts are resolved and its proof still applies to the final head.

options.title: Maintainer override
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly override the proof gate, but that would accept the rendering and delivery-risk uncertainty for this branch.

recommendation.title: Require proof on this branch
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open but require redacted Feishu client/API proof plus conflict resolution before considering it canonical.
